data.define: A short way to say you feel or do the same.

misuse.text: Don't say 'same' to someone who is grieving.
misuse.why: It sounds careless without real comfort.

publish.title: What does "same" mean?
publish.value: Same = Me too. Example: "Tired already? Same." (casual English).
